question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (1)
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 2.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**about**" is the correct preposition to use with "concerned" when referring to worrying or being anxious about something. (के बारे में चिंतित)
 
• The phrase "concerned about" is commonly used to express worry regarding a specific issue.
 
• The other options: "**at**," "**over**," and "**on**" do not fit as naturally in this context.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Concerned about__ the pollution levels and the role firecrackers played in increasing it, the Supreme Court last October banned the sale, use and manufacture of crackers that were not 'green'.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Concerned at**: This phrase is less common and typically used in different contexts.
 
• **Concerned over**: This phrase can be used but is more formal and less common compared to "concerned about".
 
• **Concerned on**: This phrase is incorrect in this context.
